about: IIIT Sonepat is a rapidly emerging center of excellence in Information Technology and Allied Disciplines. Established under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, it has been declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament. The institute is committed to nurturing talent and fostering innovation in the digital era.

The institute was established in 2014 by the Ministry of Education (MoE), Government of India, in collaboration with the Government of Haryana and industry partners HSIIDC and HARTRON, and was mentored by NIT Kurukshetra. It is envisioned as a hub of academic excellence and research in Information Technology, focused on industry-ready graduates and cutting-edge research.
